name: finjev-financial-research
description: Research financial data with Codex, use FinJev and Jev for structured judgment, and let Codex produce the final cited analysis.

interface.shortDescription: Research financial evidence, judge it with Jev, and synthesize with Codex.
interface.longDescription: Codex gathers current financial data from available sources, FinJev converts sources and evidence into versioned Jev judgments, and Codex writes the final natural-language analysis with citations, uncertainty, and review status.
defaultPrompt: Research this company and explain the financially material findings.
Verify this financial claim using primary sources and assess the evidence.
Compare these disclosures and identify what deserves deeper research.
